baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'half of it / or subtract from it / a little' names a reference share, a downward operation, and a bound on that operation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Half fixes a stable reference quantity, subtraction removes only part of it, and littleness caps the departure. The alternatives therefore form a narrow quantitative band rather than an open-ended reduction.

activation_trace.role: The literal half or one-of-two-parts image supplies the reference quantity around which the instruction turns.
Loss of part and decrease supplies the downward operation while preserving a remainder.
Smallness limits the decrement and prevents 'subtract' from becoming indefinite.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely permits an unspecified shorter amount.
changed_reading.after: The ayah sets half as a reference and permits only a small downward adjustment from it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The midpoint sense of 'half' is followed by a small relief operation, while the final root also carries an image of bearing and rising.
baseline_models.mechanism: The half can function as a temporal setpoint rather than only a fraction. A little subtraction is then a sustainability valve that keeps the practitioner able to bear the allotment and rise to it.

activation_trace.role: Reaching the halfway point turns half into a temporal waypoint or operating setpoint.
Removing a part provides the relief operation that adjusts the setpoint downward.
The branch image of carrying and rising makes the small adjustment function as preservation of load-bearing capacity.

changed_reading.before: Half and slightly less are interchangeable clock quantities.
changed_reading.after: Half is a working setpoint, and the small reduction keeps that setpoint sustainable enough to bear and rise to.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: An equitable-half branch and a defect-or-shortcoming branch meet inside an imperative that explicitly authorizes a little less.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah can hold a tension between equity and deficiency: less than the midpoint could look like shortfall, yet the command itself licenses that bounded shortfall. This makes allowance internal to obedience rather than automatically its failure.

activation_trace.role: Fair dealing and redress let the half serve as an equitable reference rather than a merely equal split.
The defect or shortcoming image exposes the possible evaluative pressure carried by doing less.
Smallness contains the authorized shortfall so that it remains bounded rather than evasive.

changed_reading.before: Any amount below the half would simply be deficient performance.
changed_reading.after: A small shortfall can be an explicitly licensed and bounded form of compliance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding command supplies the omitted activity and temporal whole: bodily standing occupies the night, with a small exception already marked. The focus ayah then resolves that night allotment as half or slightly less.

activation_trace.role: The half image supplies the principal share of the antecedent night.
Bodily standing supplies the concrete practice whose duration the focus ayah calibrates.
Night and its darkness supply the temporal whole referred back to by the focus pronouns.
The preceding small exception anticipates and bounds the focus ayah's small subtraction.

structural_cues: 73:2 issues the standing command and names the night immediately before the focus ayah.
The object pronouns in 73:3 naturally reach back to the night just named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies standing, night, and a small exception; I identify the focus pronouns with that night and take the alternatives as duration. A live alternative is that the quantities regulate recitation within the standing rather than standing time alone.

changed_reading.before: The focus gives a fraction of an unstated quantity and an unspecified action.
changed_reading.after: Stand for approximately half of the night, with a narrowly bounded option to stand a little less.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following alternative adds an upward operation to the focus ayah's downward one. Ordered, deliberate recitation then supplies a performance criterion, so the half becomes the center of a tunable range serving recital quality rather than a one-way ceiling.

activation_trace.role: The halfway point acts as the center from which either direction of adjustment can proceed.
Part-loss supplies the downward side of the calibration.
Increase and growth supply the matching upward side of the calibration.
Orderly arrangement makes measured pacing and coherence the functional result of adjusting duration.
Reading and recitation identify the concrete activity whose ordered delivery the adjustable interval serves.

structural_cues: 73:4 begins with another 'or' and the opposite imperative 'increase upon it.'
The increase is immediately followed by the command to recite in a measured ordering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decrease, increase, ordered arrangement, and recitation; I supply the arrow from two-sided duration adjustment to recital quality. 'Upon it' could instead modify only the half, but that still leaves the focus amount as a tunable center.

changed_reading.before: The half is a fixed target with permission only to shorten it.
changed_reading.after: The half is the center of a reversible range, shortened or lengthened to sustain ordered recitation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A non-dominant mapped branch turns increase into carrying provisions, while the next ayah depicts receiving a heavy load. Together with the focus branch of carrying and rising, the small reduction becomes an anti-overload control and possible increase becomes added provision for bearing what arrives.

activation_trace.role: Carrying and rising give the focus's littleness a load-bearing capacity image.
Removing part functions as relief from excessive load rather than simple loss.
The split-root branch of carrying provisions for transition makes increase function as added capacity for a demanding passage.
Receiving speech by taking and instruction supplies the transfer that the night practice prepares one to bear.
Burdening by a load supplies the pressure against which the focus amount is calibrated.

structural_cues: The adjustable night measure is followed immediately by the announcement of a weighty utterance.
The packet preserves a non-dominant ز و د mapping under the context root ز ي د.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provisioning, speech-reception, and burden images; I infer that dosage adjustment prepares carrying capacity. The live alternative is that weight describes only the utterance's gravity, with no causal relation to the preceding duration.

changed_reading.before: Subtracting a little merely shortens the exercise.
changed_reading.after: Subtracting a little prevents overload, while possible increase provisions the reader to receive and carry the weighty utterance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The night interval is described through congruence and uprightness: pressure or footing corresponds more strongly, and speech is more straight. The focus's near-half range can therefore be read as an entrainment window aligning body, temporal pressure, and utterance.

activation_trace.role: Equal balance of features gives the half a latent image of coordinated balance rather than bare division.
Uprightness, moderation, and straightness supply the verbal alignment produced in the night interval.
One thing corresponding with another supplies the entrainment mechanism linking footing, time, and speech.

structural_cues: 73:6 compares night arising as stronger in impact or footing and more upright in speech.
Both comparative qualities follow the adjustable night measure of 73:2-4.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies correspondence and uprightness; I infer that the calibrated duration causes embodied-verbal entrainment. Alternatively, 73:6 may praise night generally without explaining why the focus specifies a near-half range.

changed_reading.before: The near-half amount is only a quantity of time.
changed_reading.after: The near-half amount marks a window in which bodily pressure and utterance can come into firmer alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Day opens into a long field of running or swimming movement. Against that expansive flow, the bounded half-night interval operates as a temporal counterweight: a stable enclosure is cut from the cycle before daytime dispersal resumes.

activation_trace.role: The temporal midpoint supplies a stable counterweight within the night-day cycle.
Opening and widening until movement flows makes daytime an expansive temporal field.
Running and swimming supply the image of sustained daytime movement and dispersal.
Length and extension amplify the duration of the daytime flow that the night interval balances.

structural_cues: 73:7 explicitly contrasts the night discussion with a long daytime movement.
The night and day descriptions form adjacent temporal domains with different activity profiles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening day, long movement, and a night midpoint; I infer a counterbalancing relation between the domains. The alternative is a simple schedule contrast with no balancing function.

changed_reading.before: The half-night is an isolated devotional quota.
changed_reading.after: The half-night is a stabilizing counterweight to the long, dispersive flow of daytime activity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same littleness that bounds personal night practice later bounds a grant of delay to opponents, where non-haste is explicit. Repetition makes 'a little' a cadence of controlled postponement rather than a merely small magnitude.

activation_trace.role: Smallness gives the focus adjustment its bounded temporal scale.
The repeated smallness transfers that same bounded scale to a period of respite.
Deliberateness and leaving haste supply the temporal function of the repeated 'little.'

structural_cues: The exact adverb 'a little' recurs in 73:11 after the focus occurrence.
In 73:11 it directly modifies an imperative of granting time rather than rushing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition and an explicit respite; I infer that the focus's small subtraction participates in a broader discipline of bounded delay. The alternative is that the repetition is rhetorical only and does not alter the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: 'A little' only quantifies how much time is removed from the half.
changed_reading.after: 'A little' also marks a controlled cadence of delay: enough relief to suspend haste without making the interval indefinite.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah relocates exact measurement: God knows and measures the night, while humans cannot exhaustively enumerate it. Half reappears among near two-thirds and one-third, and feasible recitation is repeated, reopening the focus's exact-looking fraction as an adaptive target band.

activation_trace.role: The literal half supplies the focus's apparently exact reference quantity.
Part-loss already opens a controlled departure from exact half within the focus.
Smallness bounds the initial flexibility before the closing ayah expands its rationale.
Disclosure to the knower assigns full awareness of actual practice and human conditions to God.
The repeated half is now one observed share among neighboring fractional practices rather than the sole isolated figure.
Managing an affair through estimation and judgment places authoritative night calibration outside exhaustive human counting.
Exhaustive numerical enumeration names the human operation explicitly declared unattainable.
Ease opening after difficulty supplies feasibility, rather than exact enumeration, as the practical control rule.

structural_cues: 73:20 places half beside near two-thirds and one-third in observed night standing.
It explicitly contrasts divine measuring with human inability to enumerate the night.
The instruction to recite what is feasible occurs twice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies varied fractions, divine measuring, failed human enumeration, and repeated feasibility; I infer that these cues retroactively define the focus fraction as an adaptive band. A live alternative is that 73:20 is a later accommodation governing recitation without redefining the initial near-half target.

changed_reading.before: The focus demands practical precision around an exact half-night measurement.
changed_reading.after: The half is a disciplined reference inside a divinely known but humanly non-enumerable range, implemented through what is actually feasible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah moves from a group sharing the practice to members under sharply different bodily and social demands. The focus's fair-half branch is thereby activated as equitable calibration: a common practice can retain one reference while its realized share differs by capacity.

activation_trace.role: Fair dealing and redress make half an equitable reference capable of non-identical application.
A gathered group supplies the plural community across which the practice is distributed.
Weakening and curtailed movement supply a bodily constraint that makes identical allotments inequitable.
Traveling through the land supplies a livelihood constraint and a distinct capacity profile.
Mutual fighting supplies another demanding condition under which the common practice must be differently realized.

structural_cues: 73:20 first reports a group standing with the addressee, then distinguishes illness, travel, and fighting.
The differentiated conditions occur inside the same passage that repeats flexible recitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared group and heterogeneous constraints; I infer an equity arrow from those differences back to the focus's fair-half branch. The alternative is that the conditions justify only the closing concession and carry no social meaning for 73:3 itself.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a solitary and identical numerical prescription.
changed_reading.after: The focus supplies a common equitable reference whose realized amount can vary across a community's unequal capacities.

context_deltas.mechanism: Feasibility, protective covering from the effect of fault, and mercy distinguish quantitative decrease from qualitative defect. The focus's invitation to subtract a little need not mark failed devotion; within the closing frame it can be a protected accommodation to limitation.

activation_trace.role: The defect or shortcoming image supplies the evaluative reading that the closing context qualifies.
Ease after difficulty makes feasible performance the operative standard rather than maximal quantity.
Covering a fault and protecting its bearer from its effect prevents a constrained reduction from becoming an exposed, defining defect.
Mercy and tenderness supply the relational frame in which limited performance is accommodated.

structural_cues: 73:20 follows its feasibility instructions with seeking forgiveness and the attributes forgiving and merciful.
The closing accommodation is explicitly tied to known human constraints.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, protective forgiveness, and mercy; I infer that they separate doing less from being defective. Forgiveness could instead concern unrelated faults, so this remains a contextual qualification rather than a lexical redefinition of نقص.

changed_reading.before: Doing less than half carries the evaluative shadow of defect or shortcoming.
changed_reading.after: A feasible, commanded reduction is not itself a defect; the closing frame treats limited capacity through protection and mercy.

changed_reading.after: Like a half-reduced liquid, a bounded reduction may concentrate the interval into stronger pressure and effect.

changed_reading.after: The measured subtraction can also image a controlled unwrapping from enclosure into wakeful practice.

strongest_changes: 73:2 fixes the focus as a near-half schedule of night standing rather than an abstract fraction.
73:4 makes subtraction one side of reversible calibration around the half and links that calibration to ordered recitation.
73:5-6 turn the amount into load management and embodied-verbal alignment for receiving a weighty utterance.
73:20 reopens exact-looking measurement as a humanly non-enumerable, feasible range known and measured by God.
The closing group's unequal conditions activate half as an equitable common reference rather than an identical quota.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's midpoint-decrease-littleness sequence remained stable while context changed its function from clock measure to recital control, load valve, alignment window, equitable allowance, and adaptive concession. The split ز ي د to ز و د provisioning branch made the load model especially distinctive.

Whether 73:20 retroactively interprets the focus target or supplies a distinct later accommodation.
Whether the fairness, carrying, concentration, and covering branches register semantic force or only useful analogical activation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Half is an equitable calibration.** `ن ص ف` B001 gives one of two parts, while B003 gives fair dealing and redress. The grammar first states a half and then permits a slight subtraction; 73:20 later names differing portions and inability to enumerate them. I infer that numerical division serves equitable accommodation to real capacity. `نصفه` consequently reads not only as arithmetic but as a fair baseline subject to adjustment.

2. **Decrease is subtraction, not disparagement or deprivation.** `ن ق ص` B001 supplies loss of a part and decrease; B005 supplies repeated diminishment of a right. The nearby option to add (73:4) creates a reversible scale, while the final ayah replaces exhaustive counting with what is manageable. This structure blocks the B005 model of stripping a due: I infer that permission controls the direction and legitimacy of reduction. The imperative is a sanctioned tuning of practice, not a devaluation of the practitioner or utterance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 73:20 names near two-thirds, half, and a third, then admits failed enumeration. That later plurality makes the fair-dealing branch of `ن ص ف` newly visible and confirms that subtraction belongs to accommodation, not to repeated diminishment of a right.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A fraction functioning as equitable calibration.** **Lexical evidence:** `ن ص ف B001` is one of two halves, while `ن ص ف B003` is fair dealing and redress; `ن ق ص B001` is loss or decrease, and `ق ل ل B001` is a small amount. **Structural cue and role:** `نصفه`, a small decrease here, and the immediate option to increase in 73:4 form a bidirectional scale rather than a single rigid quantity. The fairness branch assigns that scale the role of fitting obligation to bearer. **Abductive move:** the alternatives are explicit, while I infer that their purpose is equitable adjustment in view of the heavy saying announced in 73:5. **Reading change:** the half is a calibrated baseline inside a fair range, not an isolated numerical demand.

2. **Authorized resizing of an allotted share.** **Lexical evidence:** `ن ق ص B005` concerns repeated diminishment of a right, and `ن ص ف B003` concerns giving what is due. **Structural cue and role:** the pronoun in `منه` treats the night as an apportioned whole from which a share is reduced, but the surrounding `أو` alternatives expressly authorize that reduction. **Abductive move:** the partitive construction and authorization are supplied; exploratorily, I infer that the right-image makes unauthorized erosion the contrast against which this bounded adjustment is heard. **Reading change:** `انقص` reads as a licensed accommodation that preserves the integrity of the assignment, not as casual attrition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 73:4's immediate `زد` retrospectively showed that `انقص` belongs to a reversible calibration scale, not a one-way erosion. The heavy saying in 73:5 then supplied the otherwise unstated reason why equitable resizing of the share matters.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A demanding practice is formed by partitioning duration, setting the body upright, and ordering speech into an exact sequence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The time instructions behave not only as scheduling but as compositional work: subtracting, adding, balancing, gathering, and aligning a verbal whole.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Partitioning the night
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A night interval is divided, reduced, or enlarged while the practitioner rises within it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: night and its darkness (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); nighttime activity (`quranic:root_001392:B002/m01`); bodily standing (`quranic:root_001273:B002/m01`); a small portion (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); one half (`quranic:root_001511:B001/m01`); reaching the midpoint (`quranic:root_001511:B002/m01`); removal of part (`quranic:root_001542:B001/m01`); increase and growth (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The interval is treated as workable material. Standing supplies the operative posture, while fewness, half, decrease, and increase make the night a deliberately adjustable portion rather than an undifferentiated span.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A demanding practice is formed by partitioning duration, setting the body upright, and ordering speech into an exact sequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Calibrating weight and correspondence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Quantities and bodily-verbal contact are brought into balance, agreement, and stable proportion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: known weight and measure (`quranic:root_000202:B004/m01`); equal weight and moderate quantity (`quranic:root_001273:B015/m01`); fairness and equal dealing (`quranic:root_001511:B003/m01`); thing-to-thing correspondence (`quranic:root_001659:B004/m01`); ordered alignment (`quranic:root_000540:B002/m01`); straightness and equilibrium (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The lexical field converts the regimen into calibration. Weight is matched to measure, half evokes equitable division, and the night’s stronger contact becomes correspondence among elements rather than pressure alone.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Cutting one relation does not leave a vacuum; the released affair is redirected toward an endpoint and entrusted to a keeper.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Separation extends from severance and migration to a self-sufficient palm offshoot, while reliance is tested against failed mutual delegation and lagging dependence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Beautiful non-engagement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Hostile speech is met by restrained departure conducted with fairness and visible grace.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: holding the self back from panic or reaction (`quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`); leaving and distancing without continued exchange (`quranic:root_001578:B001/m01`); beauty in conduct and action (`quranic:root_000260:B004/m01`); fairness and equal dealing (`quranic:root_001511:B003/m01`); good reputation produced by conduct (`quranic:root_000516:B007/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Departure is shaped as an ethical performance rather than a rupture driven by rage. Restraint, equitable dealing, and beauty specify the manner in which the relation is ended and the kind of public memory it leaves.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water becomes usable through a linked system of source, channel, lifting vessel, receiving basin, and controlled flow.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The vocabulary assembles an almost complete hydraulic installation beneath passages usually read through worship, speech, and cosmic direction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Opening and directing a channel
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A passage is opened and widened so retained water can be directed into a running channel.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: a river cutting the earth (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`); opening and widening until liquid flows (`quranic:root_001559:B003/m01`); swimming or flowing motion (`quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`); joining two ends (`quranic:root_001372:B010/m01`); a tree-lined watercourse in a valley (`quranic:root_001511:B007/m01`); gathered water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The channel is a continuous mechanism: openings are widened, endpoints joined, and water carried through a valley course. The daytime “swim” is thereby materialized as directed flow rather than motion without a bed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 - Proportion, Bodily Beauty, and Ethical Grace
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Beauty arises when distinct parts are properly spaced, balanced, and coordinated into a gracious whole.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: “Beautiful abandonment” is reinforced by a concrete aesthetics of even teeth, balanced facial features, distinct limbs, color, and stature.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A well-proportioned body and face
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Teeth, facial features, limbs, color, hair, and stature are arranged into a balanced visible form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: even, well-spaced teeth (`quranic:root_000540:B003/m01`); balanced facial features (`quranic:root_001511:B009/m01`); distinct and complete limbs (`quranic:root_000082:B005/m01`); bodily stature (`quranic:root_001273:B011/m01`); strongly saturated color (`quranic:root_000790:B003/m01`); white eyelashes or hair (`quranic:root_001077:B012/m01`); tooth edges and moisture (`quranic:root_001077:B005/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is anatomically specific: spacing governs teeth, symmetry governs the face, separation defines limbs, and color and hair complete appearance. Ordered recitation thus resonates with an ordered visible body.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Grace as proportionate conduct
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Ethical action is held to a balanced measure, neither retaliatory excess nor degrading retreat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: beauty in action (`quranic:root_000260:B004/m01`); fairness and equal dealing (`quranic:root_001511:B003/m01`); self-restraint (`quranic:root_000840:B001/m01`); straightness and moderation (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`); departure from a relation (`quranic:root_001578:B001/m01`); surpassing the ordinary limit in beauty (`quranic:root_001578:B008/m01`)

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Night formation and weighty reception activate a complete biological sequence from mating through pregnancy to upbringing and mature strength.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: New life grows by sustained care until it reaches maturity, firmness, and a middle stage of life.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: youth growing within a people (`quranic:root_001502:B002/m01`); increase and growth (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); nurture and completion by stages (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`); a caretaker and raised child (`quranic:root_000532:B005/m01`); recent birth and youth (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); reaching mature strength (`quranic:root_000782:B004/m01`); middle age (`quranic:root_001511:B005/m01`)

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Night measurement shades into market appraisal, while daytime movement becomes the livelihood that requires capital, provisions, and fair valuation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Weighing, pricing, and bargaining

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reducing and concentrating food

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: drink cooked down by half (`quranic:root_001511:B008/m01`); thick syrup or residue used to preserve and repair (`quranic:root_000532:B006/m01`); melted fat (`quranic:root_000260:B005/m01`); sun-dried meat (`quranic:root_000790:B002/m01`); a date-milk-ghee preparation (`quranic:root_001659:B007/m01`); wine or pressed date drink (`quranic:root_001077:B016/m01`); bitter medicinal aloe (`quranic:root_000840:B008/m01`)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kadının başına taktığı örtüyü veya bütün giysilerinin üstüne aldığı daha geniş örtüyü aynı sözlüksel ad altında verir. Örtünme ve bir kadına bu örtüyü giydirme eylemleri de doğrudan bu giysi anlamına bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel örtme eylemini değil, kadına özgü baş ya da üst örtüsünü ve onun giyilmesini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Örtü adı ile kadının örtünmesi ve ona örtü giydirilmesi eylemleri ayrılır; genel örtme anlamı dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kadının başını örten başörtüsü veya bütün giysilerinin üstüne aldığı, bakışı engelleyen geniş örtü. Kadının bu örtüyü takması ve başka birinin ona taktırması da giysi adına bağlı eylem kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Ad, kadının başını örten bir başörtüsünü gösterebilir.
Ad, kadının bütün giysilerinin üstüne aldığı ve başkalarının bakışını engelleyen geniş bir üst örtüyü de gösterebilir.
Kadının örtüyü takması veya bir başkasının ona bu örtüyü giydirmesi, giysi anlamından türeyen eylemlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kadın başörtüsünü ortak çekirdek olarak verir; daha geniş bir kadın üst örtüsü açıklamasını, örtünün bakışı engelleme işlevini ve örtünme ya da örtüyü giydirme eylemlerini de kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Baş örtüsü ile bütün giysilerin üstüne alınan örtü çeşitlerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Başörtüsünü, geniş üst örtüyü ve bunları takma ya da giydirme eylemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadının başını örten daha dar giysi türü kastedildiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kadının başını örten örtü türünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bütün giysilerin üstüne alınan geniş örtüyü ve eylem kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadının bütün giysilerinin üstüne aldığı geniş örtü kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Başörtüsü türünü ve örtünme eylemlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak başörtüsü ile geniş üst örtü arasında değişebilir; komşu dalın çekirdeği daha geniş ve bedeni örten dış giysidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak, kadına özgü belirli bir baş veya üst örtüsünü sözlükselleştirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu, nesne, ev, kap, yüz, haber ve tanıklık dahil genel örtme ve gizlemeyi kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak belirli bir kadın giysisidir; komşu dal nesnelerden bilgilere kadar uzanan genel örtme ve gizleme eylemidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir arazi biçimine indirgenmez: vadinin yamacındaki kaya, vadinin ortasındaki büyük akış yatağı, su yolu ve ağaçlı geniş arazi açıklığı aynı adın kaynak varyantlarıdır. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu varyantlar tek bir zorunlu şekil gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği vadi veya arazi içindeki yer adıdır; kaya, su yatağı ve ağaçlı açıklık birbirinin zorunlu özellikleri değil, kaynak varyantlarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca bağımsız arazi adının kaynaklarda verilen kaya, akış yatağı ve açıklık varyantlarını kapsar; yol ortası veya genel vadi anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Vadi veya arazi içinde, kayalık bir yamaç öğesi, büyük bir akış yatağı ya da su yolu veya ağaçlı geniş bir açıklık olarak tanımlanan yer adı. Bunlar tek bir yerin zorunlu parçaları değil, adın farklı kaynak varyantlarıdır.

facets.statement: Ad, vadi veya arazi içindeki belirli bir doğal yer öğesini gösterir.
Ad, vadinin ortasındaki büyük akış yatağını veya genel olarak su yolunu gösterebilir.
Ad, ağaç bulunan geniş bir arazi açıklığını da gösterebilir.
Ad, vadinin yamaçlarında bulunan bir kayayı gösterebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı yer adını vadinin yamacındaki kaya, vadinin ortasındaki büyük akış yatağı, su yolu ve ağaçlı geniş arazi açıklığı için kullanır; bu açıklamalar bağımsız kaynak varyantları olarak korunur.

error_profile.preserves: Kaya, su yatağı ve ağaçlı açıklık varyantlarını ayrı seçenekler olarak korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir içecek yapım sonucunu açıkça sınırlar: içecek kaynatılır ve başlangıç miktarının yarısı gider. Dal çerçevesi hem işlemi hem de kalan ürünün adlandırılmasını doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnızca içecekle kurulan yapıya bağlıdır; genel kaynatma, yoğunlaştırma veya herhangi bir şeyin yarısı anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca içeceğin yarısı gidene kadar kaynatılması yapısına bağlanır ve çıplak bir yarıya indirme anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir içeceğin kaynatılması sırasında başlangıç miktarının yarısı gidince elde edilen içecek. Tanım hem ısıtma işlemini hem de tam yarı kayıp sonucunu gerektirir.

facets.statement: Söz konusu ürün bir içecektir ve kaynatılarak hazırlanır.
Kaynatma, içeceğin başlangıç miktarının tam yarısı gidene kadar sürer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir içeceğin kaynatılıp miktarının yarısı gittikten sonra kalan ürünü aynı biçimde tanımlar; içecek kısıtı ve yarı kayıp sonucu ortak ve kurucudur.

concept_gloss.applicability: İçecek, kaynatma ve tam yarı kayıp koşullarının üçünü de taşıyan yapı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İçecek türünü, kaynatma işlemini ve miktarın yarısının gitmesi sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaynatma yoluyla içeceğin yarısının uçurulduğu yemek veya içecek bağlamlarında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kaynatılan içeceği ve başlangıç miktarının yarısının gitmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta ölçülebilir yarı kayıp kurucudur; komşuda sıvı türü süt, sonuç ise oran değil koyulaşmadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yüzün yalnızca güzel olmasını değil, güzelliğin yüzün bütün bölümlerine dengeli biçimde dağılmasını ve her bölümün diğerleriyle uyumlu olmasını anlatır. Dal çerçevesi bu dağılım ve karşılıklı dengeyi doğru yansıtır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca yüzün güzelliklerinin dengeli olmasını bildiren kalıba bağlanır; genel adalet veya genel güzellik anlamına genişletilmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, artışın karşıtı olan eksilmeyi, paydaki kaybı, bir şeyden bir miktarın gitmesini, bir şeyin kendiliğinden eksilmesini ve birinin onu eksiltmesini aynı çekirdek çevresinde toplar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu işlem, katılımcı ve sonuç ayrımlarını doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal genel miktar kaybını ve eksiltme işlemini kapsar; kötü yan, insanları yerme ve özel kalıp anlamları bu çekirdeğe katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eksilme kavramını korurken kendiliğinden eksilme, bir şeyi eksiltme ve eksiltilmiş sonuç bildiren kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin miktarının, payının ya da elde kalan bölümünün azalması veya birinin bu azalmaya yol açmasıdır. Kavram hem eksilme sürecini hem giden miktarı hem de eksiltilmiş sonucu anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Temel karşıtlık artış ile eksilme arasındadır; bir şeyin önceki miktarından bir bölüm gider.
Eksilme, bir şeyin kendiliğinden azalması veya bir kişinin onu azaltması biçiminde kurulabilir.
Giden miktar, paydaki kayıp ve eksiltilmiş durumda kalan şey de aynı kavram alanında adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, artışın karşıtı olan eksilmeyi; paydaki kaybı; bir şeyden bir miktarın gitmesini ve hem kendiliğinden hem ettirgen kurulumu birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir miktarın azalmasını, bu azalmaya yol açmayı ve bağlama göre eksilen bölümü birlikte temsil eden en kısa genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem kendiliğinden azalmayı hem birinin azaltmasını ve ortaya çıkan miktar kaybını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öznenin miktarının dışarıdan açık bir yaptırıcı belirtilmeden düştüğü cümlelerde kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyde bulunan kötü yanı ve bir yaşam durumuna ilişen eksikliği aynı dalda açıkça tanımlar. Bu anlam, miktarın fiilen azalmasından ve birini sözle kötüleme eyleminden ayrıldığı için verilen çerçeve kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir nesne veya durumda bulunan eksikliği ve kötü yanı anlatır; miktar azalmasını ya da sözlü saldırıyı anlatmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimlerin eksiklik ve kötü yan anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka dallardaki eylem ve özel kalıp anlamları buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyde bulunan, onu beklenen tamlık veya iyilik düzeyinin altında bırakan eksiklik ya da kötü yandır. Yaşam veya içinde bulunulan durum bakımından da olumsuz bir eksiklik anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin niteliğinde bulunan eksiklik veya kötü yan temel anlamı oluşturur.
Aynı değerlendirme, bir kişinin yaşamında veya içinde bulunduğu durumda görülen olumsuzluğa uygulanabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
